subject: general
question: Ugadi is celebrated primarily in which of the following states on the first day of the Chaitra month of the Hindu calendar?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Karnataka__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Karnataka** is one of the states where Ugadi is celebrated with great enthusiasm.
 
• The festival marks the beginning of the Hindu New Year according to the **lunisolar calendar.**
 
• Ugadi is celebrated on the first day of the Chaitra month, which usually falls in late March or early **April**.
 
• The festival is characterized by various traditions, including the preparation of a special dish called Ugadi Pachadi, which symbolizes the bittersweet nature of life.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

Some Famous Festivals in Other States:

__
 
• **Odisha**:__

 __
 
• **Rath Yatra:** A grand chariot festival held in Puri, one of the most famous festivals in India.
 
• **Ganga Jamuna:** A cultural festival celebrating the confluence of the Ganga and Jamuna rivers.
 
 
 
• **Uttarakhand**__:
 __
 
• **Kumbh Mela:** A massive religious gathering held every **12 years,** considered one of the largest gatherings in the world.
 
• **Gulaal Holi:** A unique celebration of Holi where organic colors are used.
 
 
 
• **Assam**:__
 
 
• **Bihu:** A harvest festival celebrated with traditional dances, songs, and feasts.
 
• **Rongali Bihu:** The most popular of the three Bihu festivals, marking the beginning of the Assamese New Year.
